jd:
At NUVACORE we're designing a new general-purpose CPU core for the sustained, intensive demands of AI infrastructure and agentic computing, not the workloads of the past. As a member of the CPU-software team, you will enable the design to achieve the target PPA (Power, performance, area) specifications by writing software and AI tools which we use in the lab. We write our own tools because custom-silicon needs custom-tools.

Telemetry is an interdisciplinary field ranging from low-level hardware interfacing, to pure numerical data analysis and GUIs. This is a chance to work with some of the best designers in the industry, in the middle-the intersection of hardware and software, of design and implementation, across pre and post-silicon.

Nobody will match every line of the list below, and we’re not expecting you to. Tell us which dimensions you’re strong on, and we’ll see where you fit in. Note you must be flexible and willing to grow in all dimensions. We will help you grow.

THE ROLE



- Understand how computer performance is measured. 
- Understand how computer performance is measured at different levels of abstractions. 
- Peel the onion to relate wall-time scores to low-level telemetry. For example, going from “this is slower” to “this is saturating memory bandwidth”. 
- Understand how computer performance is tuned re-tuned. 
- Understand how computer performance happens by running specific workloads (like geek-bender!) and gleaning insights into their operation. 
- Develop a tool suite and telemetry architecture to process data from the hardware to the user. 
- Understand how hardware works, firmware, OS, device drivers, and how programs work. 
- Can you make AI in the lab work with a new chip nobody has seen before? Work on Agents, MCP servers, LLMs. 


Minimum Qualifications



- Currently an Undergraduate in CE, EE, CS or NΨ. 
- Familiarity with Computer Architecture and hardware fundamentals. 
- Exceptional ability with some of the following: AI, System Programming, Computer Architecture or Computer lab operations. 
- Strong communication and collaboration skills, comfortable working directly with foundry, CAD, and physical design partner teams. 
- Flexible and open to tackling any challenge. 


Requirements — Preferred



- Loves coding, experimentation, collaborating and sharing results with others. 
- Has strong persistence and is self-driven. 
- Wants to develop an Encyclopedia-like knowledge of a modern CPU and SOC w.r.t. performance. 


The next great CPU won't build itself. We’re assembling a world-class team across every layer of CPU development, from architecture and design to verification, physical implementation, software, infrastructure, and product delivery. Every discipline matters, and every person has the opportunity to help shape the technology from the ground up.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
fit_why: Low-level CPU performance telemetry and hardware focus; candidate lacks hardware/systems background

jd:
At Sun Life, we’re driven by our Purpose: helping our  Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.  

Our student and new graduate programs offer a chance to explore Sun Life from the inside. You’ll make a difference in the lives of our customers and communities, while building the skills and experience that allow you to grow in a meaningful and rewarding way.

Job Description

HYBRID

This co-op opportunity is in person, remote or hybrid. For remote or hybrid, you will be required to work within the province. Remote work outside of the province will not be a possibility.

This role requires Reliability Status Clearance. In addition to a law enforcement inquiry and a credit check, as part of your application, the Government of Canada will ask if you lived or travelled outside of Canada for 6-consecutive months during the last 5 years, and you must account for all activities during this time. Important: Obtaining Reliability Status Clearance within a reasonable amount of time is a condition required to start employment for this role at Sun Life.

You will be joining one of our exciting teams in Corporate IT. At Corporate IT, our team is focused on enabling technology at Sun Life by delivering robust, scalable, secure and reusable platforms and services that operate within our Enterprise Cloud, API and DevOps environments. In this role, you will contribute as a software engineer while helping embed security practices into the design, development, testing and operation of project solutions.

What will you do?



- Under the guidance of a Senior Engineer, contribute to the development, testing and deployment of APIs
- May assist in gathering functional requirements, developing technical specifications and test plans with internal team members and external partners
- Work within an Agile pod to enable ML/AI/Gen AI Use Cases and experiments, build core data and analytics platforms, applications and self-service capabilities.
- Apply secure software development practices when designing, coding, testing and deploying APIs and applications, including identifying and helping remediate security vulnerabilities
- Support security control testing by documenting results, identifying gaps and helping align solutions with recognized industry practices and frameworks such as NIST
- Research emerging security technologies and contribute to the evaluation of security tools, processes and engineering approaches for cloud, API, DevOps, data and AI solutions
- Support in system or project documentation
- Work in a cross-functional Agile Scrum team
- Learn new technologies and tools related to Gen AI, ML/AI, data integration and warehousing

What do you need to succeed?



- Currently pursuing a master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity or a related technology discipline
- Enthusiasm, professionalism, and willingness to learn
- Fast learner with a keen interest in picking up new technologies
- Strong coding, debugging and problem-solving skills
- Knowledge of an object-oriented programming language such as C# or Java
- Familiarity of Python, Microsoft .Net core, .Net, Java Springboot framework
- Familiarity with SQL for relational or NoSQL databases
- Demonstrated interest in cybersecurity and secure software engineering, with an understanding of common application, API, cloud or DevOps security risks
- Familiarity with security testing, vulnerability management, threat modelling, security controls or industry frameworks such as NIST is considered an asset
- A graduation date of April 2027 or later is required. 

What is in it for you?



- A friendly, collaborative, and inclusive culture where you’re an innovator and trusted partner
- An environment of continuous learning and improvement
- We’re honoured to be recognized as a 2023 Best Workplaces in Canada by Great Place to Work® Canada
- Gain experience with a development team that uses some of the cutting-edge development technologies such as Azure DevOps, MongoDB, Kafka, Docker and Kubernetes, Gen AI/ML

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted for. The Base Pay which you will be considered for will vary depending on the Campus program you are selected for.

Eligible Sun Life employees for various Campus Graduate programs will also participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Job Category

Temporary Employee

Posting End Date

01/11/2026
fit_why: Security-focused SWE; needs master's, C#/.NET and security depth he lacks
